welcome.title: overwatch server selector

tour.servers.title: server list
tour.servers.body:
click a server to block or unblock it. right click selects only that server and blocks the rest.
faded servers are blocked, colored ones are allowed. the icon next to the name shows ping quality.
tour.mini.title: mini mode
tour.mini.body: this button shrinks the window and hides the details (only the server list stays). press it again to bring them back.
tour.disable.title: disable dropship
tour.disable.body: removes every block instantly. if you are failing to connect to a server while in a competitive queue, press this quickly to avoid a ban.
tour.games.title: games
tour.games.body: the game executables the blocks apply to. they are detected automatically when the game is open, or add one yourself with "add one". click a game to browse its files or forget it.
tour.stars.title: block summary
tour.stars.body: one star per server: colored is allowed, faded is blocked. hover to see which server, and the blocked count is shown next to them.
tour.notices.title: welcome tab
tour.notices.body: the latest notice from the developer, such as server changes or important warnings.
tour.log.title: log tab
tour.log.body: everything that happens inside the app: connection, blocks, errors. click the status message at the top of the window to open it quickly.
tour.help.title: help tab
tour.help.body: discord and github links for support or feature requests, and a button to replay this tour.
tour.options.title: options tab
tour.options.body: export blocked ips, wipe cache, reset the firewall, window size, theme, language, and whether blocks are permanent or only while dropship is open.
tour.status.title: status bar
tour.status.body: shows the latest message for a few seconds: red is an error, orange is a warning. click it to open the log.
tour.footer.title: shortcuts
tour.footer.body:
esc closes the app and the keys 1 to 4 switch tabs. the two icons show the mouse buttons: left toggles a server, right inverts the rest.
blocks stay active even after the window is closed.
